about: Shared cases for the banned-phrase matcher. Each text lists the banned.txt lines it must hit, in banned.txt order. Checked by `politricks lint --self-test` (pipeline/politricks/lint.py) and `node scripts/check-api.mjs` (src/lib/banned.ts), so the pipeline and the live Explain API can't disagree about what is banned. Written by hand from the rules in banned.txt's header, not generated by either matcher.

vectors.text: Members have voted and votes are counted.
You should file early, and you shouldn't wait.
You must make sure you pay.
The CEO has no voting rights on the Board.
Section 3 ina-state purpose ya hii Act.
